appointments_schedule_order_check.name: appointments_schedule_order_check
appointments_schedule_order_check.value: "appointments"."scheduled_end" is null or "appointments"."scheduled_start" is null or "appointments"."scheduled_end" > "appointments"."scheduled_start"

attendance_staff_times_check.name: attendance_staff_times_check
attendance_staff_times_check.value: "attendance_staff"."check_out_at" is null or "attendance_staff"."check_in_at" is null or "attendance_staff"."check_out_at" >= "attendance_staff"."check_in_at"

enrollments_plan_check.name: enrollments_plan_check
enrollments_plan_check.value: "enrollments"."planned_sessions" between 1 and 500 and "enrollments"."sessions_per_week" between 1 and 14 and "enrollments"."session_minutes" between 15 and 240
